verdict.rationale: Docs show the Customer Agent working as a team member inside Intercom, Zendesk, Front, Plain, and Pylon. It can take real actions through API tools such as Stripe refunds, gated or auto-approved, which supports end-to-end resolution rather than simple deflection. A changelog line says agents 'resolve tickets' across channels, and the Internal Agent can report on where the Customer Agent falls short. Missing for 10: any published resolution-rate metric or share of conversations fully resolved, a documented distinction between resolutions and deflections or bounces in reporting, and independent or customer corroboration of resolution outcomes.
